title: Note IT
summary: A notes app built with a classmate. It saves to local storage and lets you dictate notes by voice.
description: We built a notes app with JavaScript, HTML and CSS and used local storage to save data. Users can speak a note, have it converted to text and stored, and play it back.
learned: I learned how to add voice input and playback features.

title: Movie Box
summary: A cinema app where you register, order movies and vote for the Friday Movie Night selection.
description: Using the databases and APIs from our teacher, users can register, log in, order movies, search and vote. Admins can create and delete movies.
learned: The value of simplicity and accessibility: arrange features by what users find most useful.

title: WorthIt
summary: Money = time. An expense tracker that shows what you spend in hours of work, with categories and analytics.
description: ASP.NET Core MVC app with SQLite and Entity Framework Core. Add expenses, manage categories and see analytics.
learned: Backend structure with MVC, migrations and unit tests.

title: Tasbeeh Challenge
summary: A tasbeeh counter app with challenges and a leaderboard, installable as a PWA.
description: A counter app with friends, challenges, levels and a leaderboard. Installable on your phone.
learned: PWA, service workers and designing a satisfying counter interaction.

title: BOV Trofee
summary: Website design for the BOV Trofee, an annual award for entrepreneurs with vision in the Hart van Brabant region.
learned: Designing a campaign site around one clear theme.

title: Finance Tracker
summary: A dynamic finance dashboard with transaction tracking, goal setting and personalised finance tips.
description: FinSmart is a finance tracker built with the MERN stack: a place where people can easily watch their spending and save up for the things they want.
learned: I improved my Node.js skills and learned to focus on what users need. Making the dashboard user-friendly was the big lesson.

title: Kras Hosting
summary: A platform for ordering hosting packages, with an admin dashboard for orders and blogs. Built with three classmates.
description: Our first project using Scrum. We reached about 90% completion. Users can order hosting packages, and admins manage orders, packages and a blog.
learned: Scrum taught me to break work into smaller parts, set short-term goals and hold regular team meetings.
